task:
Add mega menu dropdowns to all primary navbar tabs in Navbar.tsx.

BUY mega menu (3 columns): By Type (Apartments, Villas, Townhouses, Penthouses, Land for Sale, Offices), Popular Areas (Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, JVC, Dubai Hills), Browse By Budget (Under AED 1M, 1M-3M, 3M-10M, 10M+, Buy with Crypto). RENT mega menu (2 columns): By Type, Popular Areas. OFF-PLAN mega menu (2 columns): By Type, Browse. GUIDES tab (new, mega menu): Investment Guides + How It Works. SERVICES mega menu (2 columns): For Buyers, For Sellers.

stages.spec:
GOAL: Replace the plain Buy/Rent/Off-Plan links and the simple Insights/Company dropdowns in src/components/Navbar.tsx with multi-column MEGA MENUS, add a new standalone GUIDES tab, and rename the Company dropdown to SERVICES (also a mega menu). Keep the dark-glass navbar aesthetic identical to the existing Insights/More dropdowns. Desktop = hover-activated wide panels. Mobile = nested accordion. Every link MUST resolve to a route that exists.

## Why this will be good
Nav becomes a discovery surface, not just a router. By Type + Popular Areas + Budget columns let a buyer self-segment in one hover instead of digging through /search. Benchmark: Zillow / Bayut mega nav — categorized, scannable, with a clear 'browse all' escape hatch per panel. Production-ready bar: no horizontal scroll at any width, 44px mobile tap targets, panels reuse the EXACT glass treatment already on screen so nothing looks bolted-on, hover intent does not flicker when moving diagonally into the panel.

## VISUAL DIRECTION (match existing, do not invent)
The Insights dropdown (lines ~177-201) and More/Company dropdown (lines ~203-227) are your style reference. Reuse their exact treatment for mega panels:
- Panel wrapper: AnimatePresence + motion.div with initial {opacity:0, y:-8} animate {opacity:1, y:0} exit {opacity:0, y:-8}, transition duration 0.15. Outer wrapper keeps the `absolute top-full left-0 pt-2` (the pt-2 is the hover-bridge gap — preserve it so the cursor can cross from trigger to panel without closing).
- Inner panel: same glass as today — `rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-xl border border-white/10` with inline style `background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0B3D2E, #1A7A5A)`. Add `backdrop-blur-xl` to the inner panel. z-index: panels at z-[60].
- Min-width: ~700px for the 3-column BUY panel, ~500px for the 2-column panels (Rent, Off-Plan, Guides, Services). Lay columns out with a grid (e.g. grid-cols-3 / grid-cols-2) and a sensible gap; DEV picks exact padding/gap to match the visual rhythm of existing dropdowns.
- Column header: small uppercase label, text-white/50, ~text-[10px], tracking-[0.2em], with a subtle bottom separator (margin or border-b border-white/10). 
- Column links: reuse the existing dropdown link feel — text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10, ~text-[13px], comfortable padding (~px-4 py-2.5), rounded on hover. These are NOT uppercase tracking like top-level tabs — keep them readable sentence/title case at normal tracking (the labels below are the display strings).
- Bottom CTA row: full-width, separated by border-t border-white/10, gold-tinted link(s) using the accent color (text-accent hover:text-white). Include the → arrow in the label or as an icon.
- Each trigger button keeps a ChevronDown that rotates 180° when its panel is open (match existing Insights pattern exactly), plus keep the animated accent underline span the primary tabs/dropdowns already use.

## TRIGGER BEHAVIOR (desktop)
Convert Buy, Rent, Off-Plan from plain handleNav buttons into hover-dropdown wrappers identical in structure to the existing Insights wrapper: a `relative` div with onMouseEnter (open this panel, close all others) / onMouseLeave (close this panel), a trigger button, and the AnimatePresence panel. The trigger button itself should STILL navigate on click to its base route (Buy→/search?intent=buy, Rent→/search?intent=rent, Off-Plan→/search?status=Off-Plan) so clicking the tab works while hovering reveals the panel. Add Guides as a brand-new hover wrapper (trigger navigates to /pulse/guides on click). Rename the Company wrapper trigger label from t('company') to t('services') and turn its panel into the Services mega menu (trigger click → /services). Add one boolean open-state per new panel (e.g. buyOpen, rentOpen, offPlanOpen, guidesOpen) and reuse moreOpen for Services (or rename to servicesOpen for clarity). Each onMouseEnter must close every OTHER panel so only one is open at a time (the existing Insights/More code already does this pairwise — extend it to cover all panels).

## OUTSIDE-CLICK / REF CLOSE
The existing useEffect (lines ~97-106) closes moreOpen/insightsOpen on outside mousedown via refs. Add a ref for each new wrapper and close its state the same way, OR consolidate. Do not leave any panel that can get stuck open. Since these are hover panels, onMouseLeave is the primary close; the ref-based close is the safety net — keep it consistent with current code.

## EXACT MENU CONTENTS (lock these — labels are display strings, hrefs must be used verbatim)
BUY (3 columns + CTA):
- Col1 header t('megaBuyByType'): Apartments /apartments | Villas /villas | Townhouses /townhouses | Penthouses /penthouses | Land for Sale /land-for-sale | Offices /offices
- Col2 header t('megaBuyAreas'): Dubai Marina /buy-property-in/dubai-marina | Downtown Dubai /buy-property-in/downtown-dubai | Palm Jumeirah /buy-property-in/palm-jumeirah | Business Bay /buy-property-in/business-bay | JVC /buy-property-in/jumeirah-village-circle | Dubai Hills /buy-property-in/dubai-hills-estate
- Col3 header t('megaBuyBudget'): Under AED 1M /search?intent=buy&maxPrice=1000000 | AED 1M-3M /search?intent=buy&minPrice=1000000&maxPrice=3000000 | AED 3M-10M /search?intent=buy&minPrice=3000000&maxPrice=10000000 | AED 10M+ /search?intent=buy&minPrice=10000000 | Buy with Crypto /buy-with-crypto
- CTA t('megaBuyCtaAll') → /search?intent=buy

RENT (2 columns + CTA):
- Col1 header t('megaRentByType'): Apartments /search?intent=rent&type=Apartment | Villas /search?intent=rent&type=Villa | Townhouses /search?intent=rent&type=Townhouse | Offices /search?intent=rent&type=Office | Warehouses /warehouses
- Col2 header t('megaRentAreas'): Dubai Marina /search?intent=rent&community=dubai-marina | Downtown Dubai /search?intent=rent&community=downtown-dubai | Palm Jumeirah /search?intent=rent&community=palm-jumeirah | JVC /search?intent=rent&community=jumeirah-village-circle | Business Bay /search?intent=rent&community=business-bay
- CTA t('megaRentCtaAll') → /search?intent=rent

OFF-PLAN (2 columns + CTA):
- Col1 header t('megaOffPlanByType'): Apartments /search?status=Off-Plan&type=Apartment | Villas /search?status=Off-Plan&type=Villa | Townhouses /search?status=Off-Plan&type=Townhouse | Penthouses /search?status=Off-Plan&type=Penthouse
- Col2 header t('megaOffPlanBrowse'): New Launches /off-plan | Construction Updates /construction-updates | Off-Plan by Developer /developers | Payment Plans /search?status=Off-Plan
- CTA t('megaOffPlanCtaAll') → /off-plan

GUIDES (NEW standalone tab, 2 columns + CTA):
- Col1 header t('megaGuidesInvestment'): Best Areas in Dubai 2026 /pulse/guides/best-areas-dubai-2026 | Buying as a Foreigner /pulse/guides/buying-as-foreigner | Rental Yield Explained /pulse/guides/rental-yield-explained | Dubai vs Abu Dhabi /pulse/guides/dubai-vs-abu-dhabi
- Col2 header t('megaGuidesHow'): How to Buy Property /pulse/guides | Mortgage Guide /mortgage | Golden Visa Guide /golden-visa | Valuation Tool /valuation
- CTA t('megaGuidesCtaAll') → /pulse/guides
- Trigger label: reuse EXISTING t('guides') key (already in all 4 locales — do NOT add a duplicate 'guides' key).

SERVICES (replaces Company dropdown, 2 columns + multi-CTA row):
- Col1 header t('megaServicesForBuyers'): Buy Property /buy | Mortgage Calculator /mortgage | Property Valuation /valuation | Golden Visa /golden-visa
- Col2 header t('megaServicesForSellers'): Sell Your Property /sell | List Your Property /list-your-property | Real Estate Marketing /real-estate-marketing | Free Valuation /valuation
- CTA row (three links in one border-t row): t('megaServicesCtaAll') → /services | t('about') → /about | t('contact') → /contact (About and Contact MOVE here; the old moreNav array's about/contact items are absorbed into this row).

INSIGHTS (keep as simple dropdown, just TRIM the array to 3 items): Pulse /pulse | Communities /communities | News /news. Remove Dubai Report, Areas, Valuation, Guides from insightsNav (they now live in other menus or are deprecated from this dropdown).

## MOBILE (accordion)
Each mega menu becomes an accordion section in the existing fullscreen mobile overlay, following the existing mobileInsightsOpen / mobileCompanyOpen pattern (lines ~524-568):
- Add state vars: mobileBuyOpen, mobileRentOpen, mobileOffPlanOpen, mobileGuidesOpen, mobileServicesOpen.
- Buy/Rent/Off-Plan currently render as plain primaryNav buttons (lines ~476-488). Convert each into an accordion row (tap toggles open; ChevronRight or ChevronDown rotates — match existing accordion chevron behavior).
- Inside each accordion: flatten ALL links from that desktop mega menu into one indented list (use the existing indented style: pl-4 border-l-2 border-accent/40 ml-3, link rows min-h-[44px]). Column headers are OPTIONAL on mobile — you may show them as small muted sub-labels for grouping, or omit. Include the CTA link(s) at the bottom of each accordion list.
- Add Guides as a new accordion row. Rename the Company accordion to Services and populate with the Services links + the about/contact + all-services CTA.
- Keep Insights accordion but trim to the 3 items (Pulse, Communities, News).
- When opening any accordion, close the others (the existing toggles already do pairwise close — extend so opening one closes the rest, to avoid a very long scroll).
- Every tappable row >= 44px min-height. No horizontal scroll at 320px.

## i18n — add these keys under 'nav' in ALL 4 files (messages/en.json, ar.json, ru.json, zh.json)
For ar/ru/zh use the SAME English string as placeholder (human translator refines later) — build must pass with all 4 files having every key. ADD (do NOT add 'guides' — it already exists):
megaBuyByType:'By Type', megaBuyAreas:'Popular Areas', megaBuyBudget:'Browse By Budget', megaBuyCtaAll:'Browse all properties for sale', megaRentByType:'By Type', megaRentAreas:'Popular Areas', megaRentCtaAll:'Browse all rentals', megaOffPlanByType:'By Type', megaOffPlanBrowse:'Browse', megaOffPlanCtaAll:'View all off-plan projects', megaGuidesInvestment:'Investment Guides', megaGuidesHow:'How It Works', megaGuidesCtaAll:'All guides & insights', megaServicesForBuyers:'For Buyers', megaServicesForSellers:'For Sellers', megaServicesCtaAll:'All services'.
Note: t('services'), t('about'), t('contact') keys already exist — reuse them.

## CONSTRAINTS / GOTCHAS
- Keep `Link from next/link` as-is (already imported, acceptable in this file per PROJECT_CONTEXT). All router hooks stay from @/navigation. Continue using the existing handleNav(href) pattern for navigation so router.push goes through @/navigation.
- TypeScript strict: no `any`. Type the new menu data arrays explicitly (e.g. a typed array of {label, href}, columns as arrays of such). `npx tsc --noEmit` MUST pass.
- ESLint i18next/no-literal-string: do NOT hardcode visible UI strings — column headers and CTA labels must go through t(). The link LABELS (Apartments, Dubai Marina, etc.) are many; follow whatever the existing insightsNav/moreNav items do — those use t() per label. Add per-link i18n keys IF the existing arrays do (check messages/en.json for keys like 'apartments','villas','dubaiMarina'); if such keys do not already exist, prefer adding them under 'nav' for all 4 locales rather than hardcoding, to avoid breaking the lint-gated Vercel build. Confirm by grepping messages/en.json before deciding. This is the single most likely build-breaker — verify it.
- Do NOT introduce new fixed/floating elements. Panels are absolute within their relative wrapper only.
- Hover intent: preserve the pt-2 bridge on the panel wrapper so diagonal cursor movement from trigger into panel does not close it (the existing Insights dropdown already does this — copy it).
- Do not break the existing right cluster (currency, language, phone, bell, favorites, UserMenu) or the mobile account card / contact actions — those are out of scope, leave untouched.

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes; `npm run build` (or next lint) passes with no i18next/no-literal-string violations and no missing-key errors across all 4 locales.
2. Desktop: hovering Buy shows a 3-column panel; Rent/Off-Plan/Guides/Services show 2-column panels; only one panel open at a time; chevrons rotate; panels match the existing glass style; clicking a tab still navigates to its base route; every link navigates to the correct href listed above.
3. Insights dropdown now shows exactly Pulse, Communities, News.
4. Mobile: each section is an accordion that expands to show all its links (flattened) + CTA; 44px tap targets; no horizontal scroll at 320px and 390px.
5. No console errors; no panel gets stuck open; no overlap with the right cluster.

## DEMO PATH
1. Load home page on desktop (>=1024px). 2. Hover 'Buy' in the navbar → 3-column mega panel appears with By Type / Popular Areas / Browse By Budget + 'Browse all properties for sale →' CTA. 3. Move cursor to 'Rent' → Buy panel closes, Rent 2-col panel opens. 4. Click 'Apartments' under Buy → lands on /apartments. 5. Hover 'Guides' (new tab) → Investment Guides / How It Works panel. 6. Hover 'Services' → For Buyers / For Sellers + About/Contact CTA row. 7. Resize to 375px, open hamburger → tap 'Buy' accordion → all buy links expand indented; tap a link → navigates and menu closes.
